title: Schedule of Cancellation and Interruption Sums Insured — Travel Protection Plans
content:
The cancellation benefit of a Travel Protection Plans certificate is stated as a percentage of the declared trip cost, and so is the interruption benefit. Where the plan covers cancellation for any reason, the schedule also states the percentage of the trip cost reimbursed on such a claim and the hours before departure by which notice of it must be given.

| Plan | Trip cancellation, per cent of declared trip cost | Trip interruption, per cent of declared trip cost | Cancel for any reason | Reimbursement on such a claim, per cent | Notice before departure, hours |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 75 | 75 | not covered | 0 | 0 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 100 | 100 | not covered | 0 | 0 |
| TripGuard Plus | 100 | 125 | not covered | 0 | 0 |
| TripGuard Premier | 100 | 150 | not covered | 0 | 0 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 100 | 150 | covered | 75 | 48 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 100 | 125 | not covered | 0 | 0 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 100 | 150 | covered | 60 | 48 |

Trip Basics Essential is the one plan whose cancellation benefit is below the whole declared trip cost, at 75 per cent. From Trip Basics Standard upward the cancellation benefit is the whole of the declared trip cost.

The interruption benefit exceeds the trip cost on four plans, standing at 125 per cent on TripGuard Plus and on Annual Multi-Trip Traveller and at 150 per cent on TripGuard Premier, Cancel For Any Reason Elite and Annual Multi-Trip Executive.

Cancellation for any reason is carried by two plans only. On Cancel For Any Reason Elite it reimburses 75 per cent of the trip cost and on Annual Multi-Trip Executive 60 per cent, and on both the notice period is 48 hours before departure. On the five plans that do not carry it, the reimbursement share and the notice hours alike stand at 0.

Hypothetical reading on a declared trip cost of 8000.00 USD: the cancellation benefit of Trip Basics Essential is 75 per cent of that figure, and the cancellation benefit of TripGuard Premier is the whole of it; the interruption benefit of TripGuard Premier, at 150 per cent, is half as much again as the declared trip cost.
